summary.text: DeLena Johnson has served in the Alaska House of Representatives (District 25) since 2017 and is listed as House Minority Leader for 2025 to 2026.

paragraphs.text: According to her legislative biography, she grew up in Talkeetna, earned a bachelor's degree in mathematics from the University of Alaska Anchorage and an associate degree in electronics from Mat-Su College.
It says she started a property development company in 1984, served two terms as Mayor of Palmer, and was elected president of the Alaska Conference of Mayors.
